en: The image is an old black and white postcard depicting a street scene with historic multi-story buildings. The street appears to be part of a town square with cobbled paving and several people walking. A broad, open market square leads into a narrower street lined with ornately decorated facades. The postcard text identifies the place as 'Markt mit Schlossstrasse' in 'Lissa i. P.'
